rejected: A prevention meta-analysis in women at high risk is not the timing-of-treatment trial.

source.title: Effect of early tranexamic acid administration on mortality, hysterectomy, and other morbidities in women with post-partum haemorrhage (WOMAN): an international, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
source.whyItFits: The WOMAN trial tests tranexamic acid as treatment of postpartum haemorrhage and shows that the mortality benefit is concentrated when it is given within 3 hours.
